description: SOL and SPL token balances (classic SPL Token + Token-2022) for a Solana wallet address, via public Solana RPC. Read-only. Price: $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/sol-balance

include_token2022.description: Also query Token-2022 program accounts; default true

include_zero.description: Include token accounts with a zero balance; default false

limit.description: Max token rows returned (largest UI balance first); default 100

name: sol_balance
title: Sol Balance
